changeSet.author: Abdula Basnukaev
changeSet.comment: Создаём hadith_grades для multi-grading хадисов разными учёными
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE hadith_grades ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, scholar_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES authorities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, grade varchar(20) NOT NULL, grade_citation varchar(500), comment text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), CONSTRAINT hadith_grades_grade_check CHECK (grade IN ('SAHIH', 'HASAN', 'DAIF', 'MAUDU')), CONSTRAINT hadith_grades_unique UNIQUE (source_id, scholar_id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_hadith_grades_source ON hadith_grades(source_id); CREATE INDEX idx_hadith_grades_scholar ON hadith_grades(scholar_id);
